payload.summary: Extract 6 reusable rapid-analysis skills from expert roundtable transcript (Bàn tròn kinh tế 31). Phase A: create 6 skill files under .claude/skills/. Phase B: 6 flow-file edits across market-watcher, bctc-analyst, chef, news-scout, tnb-methodology. Skills implement the Trung/Thành 4-factor framework, balance-sheet-first read, ownership governance screen, management track record verification, value-trap avoidance, and market-cap rapid screen.

phase_a_skills.description: Market-cap-first entry gate: size filter + valuation band vs. own 10-year history
Balance sheet read: asset_coverage, pb_ratio, intangible_premium, charter_capital_ratio, balance_flags
Ownership structure + insider transactions + turnover ratio + back-door listing + compensation extraction
Revenue plan accuracy + ROE trend under CEO tenure + capital deployment + public record + IR transparency
2-failure-signal heuristic (price-earnings divergence + chronically cheap) + moat check + DGC-pattern check

phase_b_flow_edits.change: Add Step 0b: rapid-market-cap-screen before ticker evaluation; SKIP-MICRO logged and dropped
Add Step 2a: balance-sheet-first-read before deep BCTC extraction
Add Step 5a: management-track-record (plan-accuracy) when governance = YELLOW
Add reference note under Layer 5 Step 3 pointing to four-factor-synthesis as bottom-up company-level input
Add Step 6a: four-factor-synthesis Scenario 4 = hard publication block
Add insider disclosure trigger: invoke ownership-governance-screen SKILL-4 Step 2; INSIDER-EXIT flag → WORK alert

constraints.no_direct_vn_market_calls: All MCP calls via call_tool(server='vn-market', ...) wrapper only
constraints.frontmatter_line_1: Each skill file must start with --- on line 1
constraints.flow_file_cap: 120L per docs/agents/*/flow/**/*.md — extract to child file if needed before adding steps
